auth_check.verification: handleUpdateMemberRole strictly requires caller to be team owner or member with admin/owner role. Non-admin members receive 403 FORBIDDEN with standard error envelope.

input_validation.verification: Arbitrary role injections (e.g. 'superadmin_exploit') are rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. Allowed roles strictly constrained to Object.values(ROLES).

idor_isolation.verification: Admin of Team B attempting to modify member of Team A is rejected with 403 FORBIDDEN.

unauthenticated_guard.verification: Requests without user identity fail immediately with 401 UNAUTHORIZED.
